root_cause: socialupload.iamwillywang.com returned 502 because the `social-auto-upload` backend container was missing entirely; openresty's upstream `proxy_pass http://social-auto-upload:5409` was failing with `connect() failed (113: No route to host)`. The previous restart manager had been Watchtower, but Watchtower had no GHCR credentials — so even after restoring the container, Watchtower could not pull image updates from `ghcr.io/willywang8216/social-auto-upload:latest`.

fix.step_1_bring_backend_up: docker compose up -d social-auto-upload (from /home/will/social-auto-upload) — restored the missing container; gunicorn listening on 0.0.0.0:5409.

step_2_switch_compose_to_ghcr_image.change: Replaced `build: .` with `image: ghcr.io/willywang8216/social-auto-upload:latest` + `pull_policy: always`. The locally-built image was named `social-auto-upload-social-auto-upload:latest`, which doesn't exist on any registry and caused Watchtower 401s.
step_2_switch_compose_to_ghcr_image.why: Watchtower needs a registry-reachable image reference to detect updates; the GHCR image is published by .github/workflows/image.yml on every push to main.

step_3_add_watchtower_labels.healthcheck: python http probe to http://127.0.0.1:5409/ — interval 30s, retries 3, start_period 60s

step_4_add_label_enable_to_watchtower.change: Added `--label-enable` to COMMAND1 so Watchtower only scans opted-in containers instead of every running container on the host.

files: /opt/1panel/apps/watchtower/watchtower/docker-compose.yml — added DOCKER_CONFIG=/config env + bind mount of the config.json
step_5_provide_ghcr_credentials.why: Watchtower only reads registry creds from a config.json file mounted at the location pointed to by DOCKER_CONFIG. Passing the PAT as env would have surfaced it in `docker inspect` output and was rejected for that reason.

verification.watchtower_one_shot: Loaded auth credentials for user willywang8216 on registry ghcr.io from file /config/config.json. Session done, Scanned=1 Updated=0 (no upstream image change yet).

next_action_for_next_agent: git add + commit + push /home/will/social-auto-upload/docker-compose.yml once you confirm the staging area.
